spec.title: Symbolic references in the own checker (H1): the benchmark's own-checker runs keep every verdict, with paths, merges and formula sizes against job 20261106-201041
spec.description: The own checker (lib/src/bmc/mod.rs) gained symbolic references (step H1 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md): where paths that differ only in which object a reference denotes meet, they now merge, the reference becoming a choice among the objects (or null) under each path's condition, where before such paths stayed apart. if_acmp, ifnull, ifnonnull and instanceof on such a reference are formulas, getfield and putfield read and write each candidate under its guard, and anything else that needs the object splits the path per candidate. A known reference stays the fast path, so a run in which no merge meets two different references must be the same run as before: same verdict, paths, merges and clauses. Every unit, integration and conformance test passed inline, including three new conformance cases (swaps, swapsOrNull, swapsThenNull) that the JVM checks. This job runs the whole benchmark on the own checker and compares each run with the recorded results (job 20261106-201041, lib/benchmark/results.json): the verdicts, and the paths, merges and clauses of every run whose numbers moved.
spec.expected: exits 0: no own-checker run's verdict differs from lib/benchmark/results.json. The second step lists the new cases (the three swaps cases of the conformance group, Verified or Violation as lib/tests/conformance.rs records them), every run whose paths or merges changed (expected: few or none outside the new cases, since only merges that meet different references are new, and those happen only past 512 paths), and every run whose clauses grew by more than 10% (expected: none). A changed verdict fails the job; a grown formula or changed path count is a finding to read.
